result.topic_en: Euler proposes evaluating simpler cases of fluid friction to compare with experiments and determine the friction constant alpha, and begins Case I: water flowing from a large upper vessel through a vertical cylindrical tube.

44. Quo autem clarius effectum frictionis cogno-
ſcamus, caſus aliquot ſimpliciores euolui conueniet, qui
deinceps cum experimentis comparari queant; vt ex-
inde valor litterae $\alpha$ definiri poſſit. Hoc autem valore
ſemel definito, reliqui caſus omnes, quantumvis fuerint
complicati, ope formularum datarum non difficulter
expedientur, atque diminutio celeritatis a frictione
oriunda determinabitur: ſed ob rationem ante allegatam
amplitudinem ſupremam $ff$ prae orificio $kk$ vehementer
magnam ſtatuemus, ita vt valor literae $\mathfrak{f}$ pro nihilo
haberi poſſit. Manifeſtum autem eſt, dummodo ſit
$f > 3k$, fore $\mathfrak{f} < \frac{1}{81}$, qui valor ſine notabili errore reiici
poterit.

que altitudo $AB = a$, quod ſemper aqua plenum con-
ſeruari pono. Huic vaſi verticaliter ſit infixus tubus
cylindricus $BBCC$ altitudinis $BC = b$, et amplitudinis
$= gg$; cuius tubi baſis ima pertuſa ſit foramine $CC = kk$,
per quod aqua effluat. Sit autem $\frac{k^4}{f^4} = \mathfrak{f} = 0$, et
poſitis

items.quote: Quo autem clarius effectum frictionis cognoſcamus, caſus aliquot ſimpliciores euolui conueniet, qui deinceps cum experimentis comparari queant; vt exinde valor litterae $\alpha$ definiri poſſit.
items.english: In order to understand the effect of friction more clearly, it will be convenient to work out some simpler cases, which can afterwards be compared with experiments, so that the value of the letter alpha can be determined from them.

items.quote: Hoc autem valore ſemel definito, reliqui caſus omnes, quantumvis fuerint complicati, ope formularum datarum non difficulter expedientur, atque diminutio celeritatis a frictione oriunda determinabitur
items.english: Once this value has been determined, all remaining cases, however complicated, will be handled without difficulty by the given formulas, and the decrease of velocity arising from friction will be determined.

items.quote: Manifeſtum autem eſt, dummodo ſit $f > 3k$, fore $\mathfrak{f} < \frac{1}{81}$, qui valor ſine notabili errore reiici poterit.
items.english: It is clear that provided f > 3k, the quantity f (fraktur) will be less than 1/81, a value which can be neglected without notable error.

items.quote: SI AQVA EX VASE SVPREMO PER TVBVM CYLINDRICVM VERTICALEM EFFLVAT.
items.english: Case I: if water flows out of an upper vessel through a vertical cylindrical tube.
